text:
sara-marketing: Hey team — need a compact creative pack for next week's webinar and the accompanying socials. Goal:
- 3 social tiles (twitter/carousel, linkedin hero, instagram story)
- 1 slide diagram that explains 'inference economics' in 3 panels
- 1 inbound routing microdiagram (how leads flow from webinar CTA -> LP -> SDR)

Constraints:
- Brand colors + accessible contrast
- Mobile-first sizes, but also provide 16:9 hero
- Deliverables: PNG exports + editable Figma file
- Deadline: first drafts by Tue EOD (48h)

Ping @jess-design for lead on visuals, @tyler-creative for motion-friendly assets. Quick notes on tone: concise, engineering-focused but accessible to PMs.

jess-design: Ok noted. Quick Qs — do we have a short headline row for the tiles? and any mandatory logo lockup? Also which color palette should we favor for high contrast (primary or alt)?

sara-marketing: Headline options: "Serve smarter, ship faster" or "Inference that scales — without surprise bills". Use primary palette for hero + alt for variant cards. Logo: full lockup required for hero, stacked logo ok for tiles.

tyler-creative: I can sketch motion-friendly frames for the 3-panel slide. Will mock with simple sparks and token-sparkline animation. Deliver PNG keyframes.

mike-growth: For inbound routing microdiagram — include UTM example and a suggested CTA copy. CTA: "Watch demo & claim credits". UTM example: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=inference-econ

jess-design: Cool. I'll start with two visual directions (clean diagram vs data-forward). Accessibility note: I'll produce accessible color variants. Quick color snippet I'm testing:
```
--primary-700: #0b3d91
--primary-500: #3461d3
--alt-400: #ffb547
--text-900: #0b0b0b
```

jess-design: Also uploading a Figma starter file now. @design-bot can you generate a quick export checklist when Figma link is uploaded? :slightly_smiling_face:

design-bot: EXPORT CHECKLIST GENERATED — include: Figma link, artboard sizes (1080x1080, 1200x628, 1080x1920, 1920x1080), font files, color tokens, PNG/JPEG/PNG-24, and layered .fig export. (automated)

sara-marketing: Perfect. Tyler — please prioritize the slide diagram + routing microdiagram first. Jess — start social tiles and variant colors. We'll sync tomorrow morning 10am to review. Thanks! :sparkles:
